tagline: Shop, ride and earn in one connected commerce platform.
summary: 1145 is LSI's flagship: a connected marketplace that brings branded online shopping together with the services needed to complete a transaction, from product discovery and merchant storefronts to delivery, rides and digital financial tools.
statusNote: 1145 Lifestyle is live as a web app at 1145.io. It runs in your browser, so there is nothing to download.

audiences.name: Consumers
audiences.description: People who want to discover, buy and receive products, and use related services, in one place.

audiences.name: Merchants and brand owners
audiences.description: Businesses that want their own storefront, with tools to list products, manage orders and reach customers.

audiences.name: Delivery partners and drivers
audiences.description: People who fulfil deliveries and rides through the platform.

capabilities.name: Marketplace and brand storefronts
capabilities.description: Browse categories, deals and new arrivals from many sellers, each with their own storefront.

capabilities.name: Merchant tools
capabilities.description: Register as a merchant, set up a store, list products, manage stock and orders, and see how the store is performing.

capabilities.name: Secure checkout and payments
capabilities.description: Pay for an order through an integrated, encrypted checkout.

capabilities.name: Order tracking and delivery
capabilities.description: Follow an order from purchase to delivery, with the logistics layer connecting merchants to drivers.

capabilities.name: Rides
capabilities.description: Request and manage rides through the same account.

capabilities.name: Wallet and rewards
capabilities.description: A wallet and rewards connected to activity on the platform. The terms on 1145.io apply to any financial feature.

capabilities.name: Mobile apps
capabilities.description: Android and iOS apps are planned. Until they are released, use the web app in your phone’s browser.

capabilities.name: Product recommendations
capabilities.description: AI-assisted recommendations are on the roadmap.

capabilities.name: More languages and currencies
capabilities.description: Multi-language and multi-currency support is on the roadmap.

requirements.label: Device
requirements.detail: Any phone, tablet or computer with a current web browser. The web app adapts to the screen.

requirements.label: Account
requirements.detail: A 1145 account, created on 1145.io. This website never asks for your 1145 sign-in or payment details.

platformNote: 1145 is a web app for now. There are no downloadable apps; mobile apps are planned.
gettingStarted: Open 1145 in your browser and create an account. You can start shopping straight away, or register as a merchant to open a store.
limitations: There are no mobile apps to download yet. Use the web app in your phone’s browser.
Which services are offered can differ by location.
Payments, wallet and rewards are governed by the terms published on 1145.io, not by this website.
